finding: RESTRUCTURED 2026-09-27 after PR #2467 review (REQUEST CHANGES): the original 869-row patchFields direction assumed every disagreement between a stored setKey and its own id segment was a wrong FIELD. Full per-row census (both twins, every stored field including sourceUrl/catalogBatch) shows that assumption held for only 31 rows (the CRA- checklist-batch-fill null-fills, where the row's OWN setName/sourceUrl already agree with its id and only the setKey field was never written) -- and did NOT hold for 838 rows (CPA- 2024 bowman-chrome 760, 90AU-/FPA- 2025 topps 77, BPA- 2024 topps 1), where the presumed-wrong row's setName/setKey/displayName are ALL internally consistent with EACH OTHER and disagree only with the id -- the signature of CF-SIBLING-CHECKLIST-DECIDES-THE-PRODUCT (backend/data/pool-relocations/2026-09-12-cpa-mg-bowman-chrome-to-bowman.json; backend/data/checklists/drew-rulings/2026-bowman-chrome-cpa-red-ink-baseball.manifest.json): a shared cardNumber prefix (CPA-) between sibling checklists (Bowman paper vs Bowman Chrome; Topps base vs Topps Celebration Series 1 vs Topps Diamond Icons) is NOT proof of product, and prior rulings for the SAME cardNumber-prefix family (CPA-MG, CPA-VF) corrected the id/address, never the field. This file now carries ONLY the 31 safe null-fills as patchFields entries; the 838 product-mismatch rows plus the pre-existing 23 CRA- isAuto=false rows (861 total) are moved to census.needsRuling with full per-row source-page evidence and two possible fixes each.

REVIEW CORRECTION (PR #2467 review, 2026-09-27): reviewer identified that the CPA- group's repair direction was unproven and cited precedent (backend/data/pool-relocations/2026-09-12-cpa-mg-bowman-chrome-to-bowman.json, backend/data/checklists/drew-rulings/2026-bowman-chrome-cpa-red-ink-baseball.manifest.json, CF-SIBLING-CHECKLIST-DECIDES-THE-PRODUCT) showing 'Chrome Prospect Autographs' is a SECTION of paper Bowman's own checklist, that 8/179 shared CPA- numbers name DIFFERENT players across the 2026 Bowman/Bowman Chrome siblings, and that CPA-JC/MG/VF were corrected FROM bowman-chrome TO bowman (the id moved, not a field). Full per-row census (this file) confirms the same shape recurs for 2024 CPA- and for the 90AU-/FPA-/BPA- groups: the 'to' row's setName/setKey/displayName are internally self-consistent and disagree only with its id -- evidence for a wrong ADDRESS, not a wrong FIELD. The original field-only PR direction is retracted for these 838 rows.

WHAT STAYS A patchFields FILL, AND WHY: the 31 CRA- rows (checklist-batch-fill source) never had a setKey field written at all (stored value is undefined/null, not merely wrong), and their setName/sourceUrl (a real checklist page URL, e.g. https://cardsmithsbreaks.com/full-checklist/2025-bowman-chrome-baseball/) already agree with the id's own product. There is no sibling-checklist ambiguity here -- the row IS the product its id says, only the field is empty. These are the only entries left in this file's entries array.

ACTION on entries: patchFields (field: "setKey") -- relocate-catalog-rows-by-list.cjs's patchFields shape now takes an optional "field" ("parallel", the existing default, or "setKey"). A setKey entry supplies NO value: the correct value is read off the entry's own id (idSetKey(id)), verified again at write time against the live id, and patched alone through patchCatalogRowFields. The id never changes.
